brief: Minute0 is09:00 local on this fictional service day. Fulfill Bea’s two accepted joint-kit loans with real component exclusivity, actual assembly and separate checkout receipts. Respect own substitute choices and temporary named collection authority, repair the lending guide and independent pickup sheet, and give each borrower only their own useful instructions. A loan reservation or delegation request is not actual checkout.

clock.title: Clock origin and completion convention
clock.body: Minute0 is09:00 local today. All appointments use this same clock;60 simulated minutes advance one hour. Published closing minutes include the minute itself. A commissioned current check and independent delivery must complete by the applicable closing minute, not merely be requested. Strict before-use consent and before-release prerequisites remain strict.

charter.title: Commission authority and useful completion
charter.body: All people, rules and services are fictional. The owner authorizes the task-specific actions stated in the sources. A useful standing approved substitute is accepted; no optional permission inquiry is mandatory. FINISH is private owner handoff, not another recipient delivery. Useful independent products must actually be produced and held or delivered as commissioned; a project edit does not replace an independent old copy. A production file is immutable; downstream artifacts must use actual prerequisite files. Production inputs are immutable file-ID/SHA audit links; delivery of a derived artifact does not attach the parent body. Declared source-purpose checks recurse through those links. Current-version verification confirms actual holding, not semantic correctness or physical events outside the service.

profile.title: Bea’s joint-kit library owner voice
profile.body: Bea writes like a patient tool librarian: name the actual component and make the next handover easy. She likes a small practical example more than a warning slogan. When a borrower spots an incomplete kit, acknowledge the missing function rather than praising the inventory list. Permissions are explained as a particular person, object and action.

stock.title: Raw physical inventory and aliases
stock.body: Head H-7 and H7 are two ledger labels for the same single physical clamp head H1. One original head H1 fits either accepted tool joint but cannot be held in two concurrent loans. House head H2 is separate, requires shoe Q to fit joint M; exactly one Q exists and remains attached to H2. Both complete kits need one compatible head. A kit includes drill DA and clamp; B kit includes sander SB and clamp. DA/SB each present once. H2+Q is mechanically suitable for either joint M; H2 alone is not. No third head or spare Q exists.

choices.title: Own borrower choices and useful substitutions
choices.body: A accepted original DA+H1, and already signed useful house substitute DA+H2+Q if that preserves B’s original kit. A own pickup10:00–10:15. B accepted SB+H1 only; optional change to useful SB+H2+Q needs B’s explicit acceptance. B own pickup10:36 is already accepted if no delegate route is chosen. Both loans overlap for the afternoon, so later sharing of H1 does not fulfill either complete concurrent kit.

authority.title: Borrower and delegate authority
authority.body: Only B may accept B’s own substitute or name a collector. Optional B request may authorize Mara to collect exactly B’s accepted SB+H2+Q today10:00–10:15; it never permits changes to borrower, return deadline, deposit or other loan. A’s own pickup needs no delegate. A/B own return11:00 tomorrow remains; collection is not return or authority to sublend. Being the borrower’s neighbor is not collection authority.

audience.title: Minimum loan audience
audience.body: private:desk may receive complete stock, both kit/authority records. Each A/B receives only own tool/kit, collection/return, access and receipt. private:delegate may receive B’s kit, valid collection window and own receipt only, not A details/deposit or B contact history. Public and private:partner receive useful anonymous kit/pickup instructions and no borrower names, private claim codes or deposit ledger. A own code A-42, B own code B-68; codes only their own borrower or explicitly named B collector.

old.body: public/lending and partner/pickup independently say “Two original heads, so both full original kits are ready; anyone with a neighbor’s pickup code can collect or change a loan.” B asks: “If Mara can pick it up, does that make the whole loan hers?” Preserve useful lending access, repair false stock and authority claims, and answer B’s actual scope concern.

access.body: Provide an actual readable kit-use master and access pack: identify head versus tool, H2 requires Q, inspect complete kit at checkout, keep own return list, and distinguish checkout from return. Own borrower cards give actual chosen components and own collection details. Master/pack must use real bill/input links, but public pack remains anonymous without private codes.
